t_advice_summary_textbox.text: the baskets pay out good for a while and then run low.  at this point switch over.  they swap over throughout the game so be mindful. the red basket is link to red purle brown and pink gnome and the yellow basket is linked to orange blue and green gnomes

vb_textbox.text: when playing this game you chose one of two gnomes. if the gnome is red, purple, brown or pink then you will get a red basket.  If the gnome is yellow orange green or blue you will get a yellow basket.  stick to the same group of colours until the basket starts giving you low numbers and then swap to the other group of colours and your numbers will increase.  if they dont, change back
